title: Time-dependent metrics and connections
summary: Time-dependent structures often appear in differential geometry, particularly in the study of non-autonomous differential equations on manifolds. One may study the geodesics associated with a time-dependent Riemannian metric by extremizing the corresponding energy functional, but also through the introduction of a more general concept of time-dependent covariant derivative operator. This relies on the examination of connections on the product manifold $\mathbb{R}\times M$. For these time-dependent covariant derivatives we explore the notions of parallel transport, geodesics and torsion. We…
